hooks.command: block() { echo "Blocked: $1 Ask a human for explicit confirmation (AGENTS.md, Security)." >&2; exit 2; }; command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || block 'jq is required to check commands.'; command -v grep >/dev/null 2>&1 || block 'grep is required to check commands.'; matches() { printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | grep -Eiq "$1"; guard_status=$?; case "$guard_status" in 0) return 0;; 1) return 1;; *) block 'The command matcher failed.';; esac; }; cmd=$(jq -ers 'if length == 1 then .[0].tool_input.command else null end | select(type == "string" and test("[^[:space:]]") and (contains("\u0000") | not)) | gsub("[\u0027\u0022]"; "") | gsub("[[:space:]]+"; " ")' 2>/dev/null) || block 'Invalid Bash hook input.'; guard_git='(^|[[:space:];&|/])git([[:space:]]+[^;&|[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+'; if matches "${guard_git}(push[[:space:]]+([^;&|]*[[:space:]])?(--force[^[:space:];&|]*|--delete|--mirror|-[[:alpha:]]*[fd][[:alpha:]]*|[+:][^[:space:];&|]+)([[:space:];&|]|$)|branch[[:space:]]+([^;&|]*[[:space:]])?(--delete|-[[:alpha:]]*d[[:alpha:]]*)([[:space:];&|]|$)|reset[[:space:]]+([^;&|]*[[:space:]])?--hard([[:space:];&|]|$))|(^|[^[:alnum:]_])drop[[:space:]]+(table|database)([[:space:];]|$)"; then block 'Destructive command.'; fi; if matches '(^|[[:space:];&|/])rm[[:space:]]+([^;&|]*[[:space:]])?(-[[:alpha:]]*r[[:alpha:]]*|--recursive)([[:space:];&|]|$)' && matches '(^|[[:space:];&|/])rm[[:space:]]+([^;&|]*[[:space:]])?(/+[*]?|~/?[*]?|\$HOME/?[*]?|\$\{HOME\}/?[*]?)([[:space:];&|]|$)'; then block 'Recursive root or home deletion.'; fi; exit 0

Resolve them before continuing.' >&2; exit 2; }; true
